subject: Kickoff: linear-eval as the portfolio's representation check
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the linear-eval standardization effort. Our open-source tooling does linear evaluation on fixed embeddings in JAX using L-BFGS, and the one-call convenience function — tune_hparams_and_compute_test_accuracy — handles the train/val split, distributes across devices, retrains at the optimal L2, and reports test accuracy. Right now every embedding team in graphs-retrieval hand-rolls this differently, which makes model comparisons across teams basically meaningless.

Goal: by mid-June, linear-eval is the blessed representation-quality check wired into Evalline, with three embedding teams migrated.

Milestones: Mar 20 library hardened + Evalline integration design; Apr 24 first team migrated; Jun 12 all three, plus a comparison dashboard.

Jelena owns staffing; Efe is tech lead. Tomas Fofana's team has the Evalline review slot on Mar 12.

Anders
